subject: Post-call: NorthBridge expansion qualification + next steps
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.inference>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@northbridgetech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-05-02T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: NorthBridge expansion qualification + next steps

Hi Elaine — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap while it's fresh and a proposed path forward.

Summary of what you shared:
- Current production usage: ~2.1M tokens/day for search & intent classification (RAG pipelines).
- Pain points: unpredictable tail latency during peak ETL windows, growing embedding costs for semantic search, and auditability for finance-owned datasets.
- New workloads being considered: conversational agent for support (low-latency), and nightly batch reranking for recommendations (throughput).

Goals we agreed on:
1) Reduce 95th percentile latency for the support path to <200ms.
2) Cut per-embedding cost by ~30% via quantization + batching.
3) Maintain isolation for finance datasets (SOC2-aligned evidence).

Proposed evaluation plan (timeline):
- Week 1 (May 3–9): Technical deep-dive with your infra team and a short profiling session to capture sequence length distribution and KV cache characteristics.
- Week 2 (May 10–16): Pilot on Redwood Dedicated (1 x reserved pool) for the support agent workload + prefix caching enabled.
- Week 3 (May 17–23): Measure latency/cost delta and iterate on batching/quantization profile.

Immediate asks from NorthBridge:
- Share a 3–5 day sample of production traces or anonymized usage (token counts by route and peak windows).
- Confirm procurement timeline and PO approver (you mentioned Daniel in finance).

Attachments: I attached a compact usage template for CSV export and an initial pricing sketch for Dedicated.

Next steps (I suggest):
- You: send the sample usage CSV and loop Daniel if procurement needs to be involved.
- Us: schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive with Rishi + Monica (we can do Wed/Thu next week).

Happy to modify the plan — call out anything I missed.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0129

Attachment stubs: northbridge-usage-template.csv, redwood-dedicated-pricing-proposal.pdf
From: Elaine Park <elaine@northbridgetech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.inference>
Cc: Daniel Cho <dan.cho@northbridgetech.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: NorthBridge expansion qualification + next steps

Thanks Kim — this is a great summary and captures the priorities. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- The support agent target is conversational responses under 200ms 95p for short interactions (avg tokens < 60). For longer context (>512 tokens) we can tolerate higher latency.
- The batch reranking is nightly and can be scheduled in the 2–5am PST window; throughput matters more than p95 for that job.
- For finance data isolation, we require proof points for audit logs (request/response retention, redaction options). SOC2 is a must for production.

Action items from NorthBridge:
- I'll pull a 5-day sample of routing logs and token counts; expect to share by EOD Tuesday (May 4).
- Looping in Daniel for procurement — Daniel, can you confirm target approval window for a Dedicated trial and any contract review needs?

Elaine
Director, Platform Operations
NorthBridge Technologies
elaine@northbridgetech.com

On procurement: Daniel, if you prefer, we can start with a 30-day reserved pilot and evaluate conversion to a 6–12 month commit. Please advise on billing contact and PO process.
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.inference>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@northbridgetech.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <dan.cho@northbridgetech.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: NorthBridge expansion qualification + next steps

Appreciate the clarifications — good to have the window details. A few notes before the deep-dive: 

- For the support agent, we'll focus the Dedicated pilot on the low-latency serving path (pin model variant + smaller sequence lengths). We'll instrument prefix/KV caching and run a lightweight tracing agent so we can split latency by kernel and I/O.
- For the batch rerank job we can prototype batching and quantized variants to hit your throughput target while cutting cost; typical cost reductions we've observed: 20–40% depending on quantization profile.
- For auditability, we have a SOC2 evidence pack and configurable request/response retention + redact-by-pattern tools — we'll bring Monica from our security & compliance team to the deep-dive to cover evidence and retention policies.

I've attached the usage CSV template again and a short checklist for the technical deep-dive so your infra team can prepare.

Proposed slots for the 60-min deep-dive:
- Wed May 5: 10:00–11:00am PT
- Thu May 6: 2:00–3:00pm PT

Please pick a slot and I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Kimberly
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: northbridge-usage-report-apr2027.csv, redwood-technical-deepdive-checklist.pdf
From: Daniel Cho <dan.cho@northbridgetech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.inference>, Elaine Park <elaine@northbridgetech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-05-04T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: NorthBridge expansion qualification + next steps

Hi all — looping in briefly from procurement.

Timeline: Finance can approve a 30-day paid pilot quickly if commercial terms are standard and we can get a statement of work + pricing. Our ideal cadence would be:
- May 10: Contract signature (30-day pilot starting May 12)
- June 12: Pilot review meeting to decide on commit level (opt for 6 or 12 months)

Checklist / asks for the legal/commercial packet:
1) Standard MSA + SOW for a 30-day trial (we need term, termination, and data handling clauses).
2) PO flow: will Redwood accept a standard NB PO? Who signs?
3) Invoice cadence for the pilot (monthly or net-30 invoicing).

If Kim can share the initial pricing sketch (the PDF attached in earlier emails) and a short SOW template we can route to legal this week.

Thanks — Daniel
Director, Finance Ops
NorthBridge Technologies
dan.cho@northbridgetech.com
